cases.name: v:0:vnc
cases.expect:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -N -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -L 127.0.0.1:40001:desk.lan:5901 jump@bastion.example & TERMIGATOR_GW=$!
trap 'kill $TERMIGATOR_GW 2>/dev/null' EXIT HUP TERM INT
for _ in $(seq 100); do
  (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/40001) 2>/dev/null && break
  kill -0 $TERMIGATOR_GW 2>/dev/null || { echo "SSH gateway "bastion" failed (see above)."; exit 1; }
  sleep 0.2
done
(exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/40001) 2>/dev/null || { echo 'SSH gateway: the tunnel did not open in time.'; exit 1; }
echo "via SSH gateway "bastion" → 127.0.0.1:40001"
vncviewer 127.0.0.1::40001
